issues.title: Support text editing in Core Mapping channel
issues.body:
The GeoMan demo page allows text labels to be added:
https://www.geoman.io/demo

Our core-mapping interface doesn't currently support this.

We need to add the ability to add and edit text labels, with these changes:
- the origin of the text label should be at the centre of the label, in the demo it appears to be at the top-left
- the padding around the text doesn't seem to be even on all sides, it should be
- we should be able to control the color of the backdrop (via feature properties)
- _maybe_ we should be able to control the font size  (via feature properties)

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/d180fe5d-7084-405f-87cb-d46eeadbf197
